system.description: By touching a device, you project your consciousness into it, granting temporary understanding of its function and operation which fades after a few minutes. Basic knowledge comes in the first turn; each subsequent turn of contact grants more, costing a Mental Trait per additional piece of information, with full mastery by the third turn. The knowledge lasts for minutes equal to half your Mental Traits (round down); using it on installed software requires touching the computer and bidding an additional Mental Trait.
system.duration: Minutes equal to half Mental Traits
